title: The Canon of Broken Patterns
summary: A canon on shattering the set pattern of a foe's technique and stance for students past the courses of the middle grade.

title: A Treatise on Entropy's Hand
summary: A treatise on letting order wear away in whatever the hand touches until guards slacken and techniques crumble.

title: The Anarchic Field Course
summary: A course in spreading chaos qi through a living field so that every pattern inside it falters.

title: The Azure Squall Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of sudden shifts in force and direction in the manner of the Azure Sky squall fighters.

title: Manual of the Sapphire Tumult
summary: A manual of roaring disorder loosed from a calm body so that foes are overrun before they read the danger.

title: The Sky-Fractured Compendium
summary: A compendium on cracking the order of a qi field so that techniques cast inside it split and fall apart.

title: The Wind-Sworn Disarray Course
summary: A course by which a wind-sworn student sows disarray in a foe's ranks and answers the gale with another.

title: Treatise on the Gale's Caprice
summary: A treatise on the wild whims of the gale turned into a field of qi that no foe can anticipate.

title: The Oath Unmade Canon
summary: A canon of the unmaking of fixed forms and sworn stances so that nothing a foe has vowed to hold can be held.
